answer: Because the lagoon audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. A farm cannot fake the aggregate without controlling every key it names, and hence paying the basalt bond on all of them and exposing each to the ember slash. Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 8 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. Each impostor pays 4 dollars up front. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
